static_traits.name: Luo Hao
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family around
static_traits.social_status: Stable relationship with friends, but struggling to communicate openly about investment troubles; has one close friend but has not yet shared the extent of negative thinking
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not yet received psychotherapy or counseling; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, highly cooperative; strong self-reflection ability; slightly tense tone but positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I often disqualify my own achievements and successes, attributing them to luck rather than ability, which causes self-doubt and maintains a negative thinking cycle.
basic_info.core_demands: I seek counseling because persistent self-doubt and negative predictions affect my ability to make rational investment decisions and enjoy my own success.
growth_experiences: I started investing in stocks a year ago, initially both excited and afraid of failure; as trading experience increased, negative thinking gradually intensified, and even after successful trades I tend to predict negative outcomes; this has affected sleep quality and increased stress.

core_beliefs: My success is just luck, not ability

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If success is attributed to my own ability, once I fail it will hit self-esteem harder and be more humiliating
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes success to luck, avoids acknowledging own ability, to reduce the psychological threat of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just luck; I will fail next time

special_situations.event: When facing the next investment decision
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I actively make decisions, I will likely fail, showing I lack ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitating and indecisive, seeking 'easy money' paths to reduce anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will probably get it wrong and lose money again

special_situations.event: When thinking about sharing one's investment troubles with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am honest about my struggles, I will be looked down on and seen as incapable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding deep sharing, maintaining surface-stable interpersonal interaction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am not capable

special_situations.event: When reviewing trades at night and thinking about the day's performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Without 100% certainty and sustained success, I cannot be said to have real ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly thinking about mistakes and potential risks, ignoring positive outcomes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today was just luck; truly capable people aren't like this

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to achieve stable success by my own ability and obtain self-recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure bringing humiliation and damage to self-worth
defense_goal: Attributing success to luck to reduce the blow of failure
Stays cautious and hesitant to avoid taking responsibility for possible failure
Avoiding being honest with others about distress to reduce the risk of being evaluated

object_relations.self_representation: Easily self-doubting investor, fearing being defined by failure
object_relations.object_representation: Possibly judgmental others (who would look down on me if they knew my troubles)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When he is asked to discuss and acknowledge his ability and contributions in successful trades
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that having one's ability recognized will make subsequent failure more humiliating and harder to bear (amplifying others' potential evaluation and the consequences of failure)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying success, emphasizing luck and uncontrollable factors; cautious and restrained tone, avoiding excessive self-affirmation, using words like 'maybe, perhaps, just a fluke'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing investment decisions or facing the next trading opportunity
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing future results will be negative, and using rational analysis to avoid emotional discomfort
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing technical details and market unpredictability, reducing emotional language; describing risk in a calm, analytical tone, downplaying personal ability and feelings.

manifestations: After success, attributes achievements to luck, finds it hard to acknowledge and experience one's own ability and worth
Difficulty enjoying the satisfaction success brings
Living alone, with no immediate family around
Struggling to express investment troubles openly to friends
outcomes: Internalized pressure, lack of external support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent self-doubt, cautiously evaluating own success
Disqualifying own ability as 'just luck' to avoid self-exposure
Tone is restrained when expressing; avoids self-affirmation

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act on other people or things, turning the energy onto themselves instead.
manifestations: Struggling to express investment troubles to friends, turning pressure and anxiety against the self
Repeatedly thinking and worrying before bed, causing declining sleep quality

positive_force: Has the ability to research companies and analyze market trends
Using technical analysis tools to time trades
Having a certain insight into my own thought patterns and willing to seek professional help
Stable relationships with friends and potential social support
Work performance not yet clearly affected, maintaining functionality and stability
negative_force: Disqualifying positive results, overly relying on external attribution (luck)
Negative predictions and catastrophizing tendencies causing indecisiveness
Self-doubt and self-blame, struggling to acknowledge ability
Avoids sharing when distressed, weakening the support system's function

target_behavior.behavior: Disqualifying achievements after successful trades and predicting negative outcomes
antecedent: Reviewing the day's trades at night
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears that if she admits ability and then fails she will be more humiliated and struck, so she uses luck attribution to reduce the psychological threat
target_behavior.function: Escaping the emotional pain of failure and impaired self-esteem, relieving anxiety short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety worsened, unable to enjoy success, declining sleep quality, decision-making affected

target_behavior.behavior: Hesitating and procrastinating before investment decisions
antecedent: When facing the next trading opportunity or needing to make a buy/sell decision
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative predictions and self-doubt causing excessive worry about failure
target_behavior.function: Escaping risk and the anxiety of reduced uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Missed opportunities, declining decision quality, pressure continuously accumulating

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing investment troubles with friends
antecedent: When interacting with friends or thinking of sharing my investment experiences and feelings
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged and seen as incapable, fearing vulnerable exposure
target_behavior.function: Avoiding shame and external negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Social support unable to function, troubles internalized, increased stress and anxiety
